# clone-team

> A Claude Code skill that orchestrates a team of AI agents (Manager, Frontend
> Developer, Backend Architect, Tester) to produce a pixel-perfect UI clone of any
> website AND a reverse-engineered ARCHITECTURE.md — with an unskippable test gate.
> Built on the dynamic Workflow engine. Pausable/resumable, login-aware, any stack.

## Install (in Claude Code)
/plugin marketplace add Varalix-Digitech-Solutions/clone-team
/plugin install clone-team@clone-team

## Use
Ask Claude Code: "Clone https://example.com in Next.js, and document how the site is built."

## What you get
- Pixel-perfect UI clone in your chosen stack (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular, or plain HTML/CSS)
- ARCHITECTURE.md: routes, observed API/network surface, inferred data model, auth/session flow, user journeys

## Key properties
- Unskippable Tester gate: the build/test loop is a deterministic Workflow program; "done" is a loop condition in code
- Scales: one builder per page, fleet sized to host free memory
- Pausable and resumable across sessions and usage-limit cutoffs (durable state.json)
- Login-aware: credentials stay in a gitignored local file, never printed or committed

## Requirements
Claude Code, Node.js + npm, a Chromium browser. Companion skills + agent-browser CLI bootstrap on first run.
